offering_description.value: Underwrites specialty property and casualty insurance, mainly excess and surplus lines, for small and mid-sized businesses. Products are sold through wholesale brokers and agents. Revenue comes from premiums and investment income.

primary_products.value: excess and surplus lines commercial insurance; commercial general liability; workers' compensation insurance; commercial property insurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized businesses in specialty and hard-to-place commercial risk classes

end_markets.value: commercial insurance; small business; specialty risks

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums written plus investment income on the insurance float

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: risk-bearing insurance carrier that underwrites policies placed by wholesale brokers and agents for businesses

geography_served.value: US national: Writes insurance in multiple US states, with a focus on Western and Southwestern markets

specialization.value: related lines: specialty commercial lines such as workers' compensation, general liability and property, mostly excess and surplus

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: wholesale brokers and retail agents who place policies for small business clients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed insurer regulated by state insurance departments, with solvency and rate and form rules

notes: Details on line mix and state footprint are from limited recall and may be imprecise.
